title: Regular quotient Roos completeness detects the canonical Koszul unit

source.place: Tag 099B (lemma-derived-completion) and Tag 0A0E (lemma-derived-completion-koszul); agent regular-generator existential-Roos/canonical-unit criterion, extracted from old Steps 6-7 of lem-sf-open-quotient-koszul-completeness.

proof.text: Apply [lem-pur-derived-complete-koszul-reconstruction] with its $K=P$ and K-flat representative $Q$. Its site, regularity, tensor complexes and strict transitions are exactly ours. It gives the strict levelwise quasi-isomorphism $a:V_\bullet\to U_\bullet$ and the isomorphism $c_P=R\lim(a)$. Write $\alpha_V:\Delta P\to V_\bullet$, $\alpha_U:\Delta P\to U_\bullet$ for the augmentations in the derived tower category. In degree zero, quotient after $\mathcal O\to K_n$ is $\mathcal O\to B_n$, and in degree $-1$ both composites are zero; hence $a\alpha_V=\alpha_U$. For the derived adjunction of [def-sf-normalized-strict-tower-augmentation], let $v_P:P\to R\lim\Delta P$ be its unit. By definition $\kappa_P=R\lim(\alpha_V)v_P$ and $\operatorname{comp}_P=R\lim(\alpha_U)v_P$, so functoriality gives $c_P\kappa_P=\operatorname{comp}_P$. Tensor and quotient maps commute with chain maps of representatives, so this comparison is natural.

Apply [lem-sf-principal-strict-limit-reflector] to the actual negative singleton Koszul tower and normalized unit. For a complete object P, the Hom bijection supplies a retraction and injectivity makes it a two-sided inverse; conversely transport output completeness across an invertible unit. Thus (ii) iff (iii); composing with the comparison isomorphism gives (iii) iff (iv).

Assume (i). The second assertion of [lem-pur-derived-complete-koszul-reconstruction] applies to this very Roos triangle and gives an isomorphism $\phi:P\xrightarrow{\sim}C_t(P)$. By [lem-sf-principal-strict-limit-reflector] the latter is locally derived complete. On every slice, applying the functor $R\mathcal Hom(\mathcal O_W[1/f],-)$ [def-pur-derived-internal-hom] to the restriction of $\phi$ gives an isomorphism to zero, proving (ii). This uses only existence of $\phi$, not an equality $\phi=\kappa_P$.

Use the proved generic strict-tower construction underlying [lem-weil-pbc-ringed-strict-tower-homotopy-limit] (CoreWork.roos_Q). Compare its pNat with the ordinary termwise limit inclusion: expand aIso and bIso, use comparison naturality along the K-injective resolution, then use naturality of the product comparison. Transport via evaluationData, cancelling the inverse evaluation isomorphism and applying piComparison_comp_π. This proves η_X p π_n = Q(limπ_n). For a strict augmentation α, naturality moves η across X(α); the ordinary constant-limit adjunction unit followed by lim(Xα) and limπ_n is α_n degree by degree. Under (iv), transport this normalized Roos triangle along the actual quotient unit. The quotient-augmentation equation identifies its first components with the prescribed actual quotient maps.

source.place: Tag 0941 (lemma-derived-limit-is-ok), Roos triangle; derived.tex Tags 09T5 (lemma-derived-adjoint-functors) and 0FND (lemma-pre-derived-adjoint-functors-general), adjunction normalization.

proof.text: For another K-flat representative, [lem-sf-principal-strict-limit-reflector] gives another reflection $(C'_t(P),\kappa'_P)$ of the same $P$ into the same locally complete objects. Its Hom bijection uniquely gives $h:C_t(P)\to C'_t(P)$ with $h\kappa_P=\kappa'_P$, and the reverse bijection gives $k$; uniqueness yields $kh=1$ and $hk=1$. Step 1 then identifies the quotient limits by $c'_Phc_P^{-1}$, carrying $\operatorname{comp}_P$ to $\operatorname{comp}'_P$. Uniqueness also makes these identifications natural and transitive. Conditions (ii)-(iv), and therefore (i), are independent of the representative. All products used above are products in the derived category, as in [lem-weil-pbc-ringed-strict-tower-homotopy-limit]; no exactness of products, finiteness or boundedness was used.

theorem regular_roos_koszul_unit
    (t : (SheafOfModules.unit (ring.{c, v, r} R)).sections)
    (_hreg : Mono (globalSectionMultiplication.{c, v, max c v r} R t)) :
    ∃ _hproducts : HasCountableProducts (DerivedCategory.{w} (Modules.{c, v, r} R)),
      ∀ (P : DerivedCategory.{w} (Modules.{c, v, r} R))
        (Q : CochainComplex (Modules.{c, v, r} R) ℤ)
        (e : DerivedCategory.Q.{w}.obj Q ≅ P)
        (_hQ : CochainComplex.IsKFlatIndependentCoefficients (R := R) Q),
      ∃ cP : koszulCompletion R Q t ≅ quotientLimit.{c, v, r, w} R Q t,
        cP.hom = comparison.{c, v, r, w} R Q t ∧
        koszulUnit.{c, v, r, w} R P Q e t ≫ cP.hom =
          quotientUnit.{c, v, r, w} R P Q e t ∧
        List.TFAE [
          (∃ (p : P ⟶ ∏ᶜ (fun n : ℕ ↦ DerivedCategory.Q.{w}.obj
                ((reductionTensorTower.{c, v, max c v r} R Q t).obj (op n))))
              (δ : (∏ᶜ (fun n : ℕ ↦ DerivedCategory.Q.{w}.obj
                ((reductionTensorTower.{c, v, max c v r} R Q t).obj (op n)))) ⟶ P⟦(1 : ℤ)⟧),
            IsDerivedLimitTriangle
              (fun n : ℕ ↦ DerivedCategory.Q.{w}.map
                ((reductionTensorTower.{c, v, max c v r} R Q t).map
                  (homOfLE (Nat.le_succ n)).op)) P p δ ∧
            ∀ n : ℕ, p ≫ Pi.π _ n =
              e.inv ≫ DerivedCategory.Q.{w}.map
                (koszulRepresentativeQuotient.{c, v, max c v r} R Q t n)),
          (∀ (W : C) (f : ((R.over W).obj ⋙ forget CommRingCat).sections),
            (∃ y : R.obj.obj (op W),
              (globalSectionMultiplication.{c, v, max c v r} R t).val.app (op W) y =
                f.val (op (Over.mk (𝟙 W)))) →
            IsZero ((derivedInternalHomOfUniverses.{max c v, v, r, w}
                (J.over W) (R.over W)).obj
              (op ((DerivedCategory.singleFunctor _ 0).obj
                (ringedSectionLocalizationOfUniverses.{max c v r, max c v, v} (R.over W) f)),
                (restriction.{c, v, r, w} R W).obj P))),
          IsIso (koszulUnit.{c, v, r, w} R P Q e t),
          IsIso (quotientUnit.{c, v, r, w} R P Q e t)] ∧
        (∀ (Q' : CochainComplex (Modules.{c, v, r} R) ℤ)
            (e' : DerivedCategory.Q.{w}.obj Q' ≅ P)
            (_hQ' : CochainComplex.IsKFlatIndependentCoefficients (R := R) Q'),
          ∃ (hV : koszulCompletion R Q t ≅ koszulCompletion R Q' t)
            (hU : quotientLimit.{c, v, r, w} R Q t ≅ quotientLimit.{c, v, r, w} R Q' t),
            koszulUnit.{c, v, r, w} R P Q e t ≫ hV.hom =
              koszulUnit.{c, v, r, w} R P Q' e' t ∧
            quotientUnit.{c, v, r, w} R P Q e t ≫ hU.hom =
              quotientUnit.{c, v, r, w} R P Q' e' t ∧
            cP.hom ≫ hU.hom = hV.hom ≫ comparison.{c, v, r, w} R Q' t) ∧
        (∀ (Q' : CochainComplex (Modules.{c, v, r} R) ℤ) (f : Q ⟶ Q'),
          koszulMap.{c, v, r, w} R f t ≫ comparison.{c, v, r, w} R Q' t =
            cP.hom ≫ quotientMap.{c, v, r, w} R f t ∧
          koszulUnit.{c, v, r, w} R P Q e t ≫ koszulMap.{c, v, r, w} R f t =
            e.inv ≫ DerivedCategory.Q.{w}.map f ≫
              koszulUnit.{c, v, r, w} R (DerivedCategory.Q.{w}.obj Q') Q' (Iso.refl _) t ∧
          quotientUnit.{c, v, r, w} R P Q e t ≫ quotientMap.{c, v, r, w} R f t =
            e.inv ≫ DerivedCategory.Q.{w}.map f ≫
              quotientUnit.{c, v, r, w} R (DerivedCategory.Q.{w}.obj Q') Q' (Iso.refl _) t)
